title: Typed report-section references; no mathematical acceptance

result_table_part.description: Canonical report schema 4 table. Exact retained rows cover unselected whole-source formalization gaps and native evidence items without comparison components. The latter render as Not assessed while retaining historical wording. Reported rows grant no mathematical acceptance or Lean endpoint. Legacy report schemas 1/2 retain their ref-only parts.

unassessed_source_item_ids.description: Exact referenced native evidence items without any comparison component; a documentary reporting state, never a mathematical category.

unassessed_source_labels.description: Display aliases from the pinned source map, or a retained caption for a single-source reference, otherwise source IDs; keys are exactly the unassessed source IDs.

condition_types.$comment: Tags do not establish provenance, necessity or a source error. Coverage describes taxonomy annotation for one condition, never the complete assumption inventory of a theorem or paper.
